relationships.subject: zavegepant
relationships.evidence_quote: Zavegepant, a high-affinity, selective, and structurally unique calcitonin gene-related peptide-receptor antagonist in late-stage development, is formulated as a nasal spray for the acute treatment of migraine.

relationships.subject: zavegepant
relationships.evidence_quote: Zavegepant nasal spray, in single doses of 10 or 20 mg, was effective for the acute treatment of migraine, with a favorable safety profile.

key_findings: Zavegepant nasal spray 10 and 20 mg outperformed placebo for pain freedom and freedom from the most bothersome symptom at 2 h in a Phase 2/3 trial.
Common adverse events were dysgeusia, nausea and nasal discomfort, with no hepatotoxicity signal.
